name: claw-sweep
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE animation strip of FIVE distinct pixel-art gargoyle poses in one HORIZONTAL ROW, chronological left to right. Use the reference character exactly: orange ochre plate armor, charcoal hinges, tan skull/claws, two icy blue horns, cyan rib reactor, folded mechanical bat wings. Right-facing three-quarter grounded character. Transparent background. No words or labels, no grid or floor. Very generous CLEAR TRANSPARENT SPACE between the five separate figures; each figure INCLUDING claws and wings must be wholly isolated, never overlapping its neighbor. Each figure's overall silhouette is roughly SQUARE, maximum width/height ratio 1.35, target about 128x128 artwork inside an exact200x200 frame. Keep anatomy consistent. Pixel art with crisp clustered pixels, no smooth brushwork or antialiasing. Composition: five small isolated complete full-body characters arranged in ONE ROW across a wide canvas; NOT a 5x5 sheet. Required sequence for claw-sweep: front claw loads backward, crouches, sweeps forward diagonally upward, fully reaches with claw slightly above head, follows through. Each pose differs. Keep extended attack claws diagonally up rather than far horizontally, so the entire attack fits.
